ring_column_source_control.integer_tail_rule: Overlap implies ||Bz||<2R_sphere, so zi^2<4R_sphere^2||inverse row_i||^2<bound_i^2. All residual integer words are tested exactly.
ring_column_source_control.note: Complete direct source, not a finite-record or optimality claim. Opposite owner supports are distinct.
ring_column_source_control.ideal_source_proof: Every vertex has horizontal squared radius R^2 and vertical coordinate +-H/2. Convexity puts the complete owner inside that cylinder. A horizontal integer word has squared length 4R^2(p^2+pq+q^2), at least4R^2 unless p=q=0. A nonzero vertical word has absolute height at leastH. Thus whole cylinders, and hence whole owners, have disjoint interiors.

construction.physical_operation: Select complete noncentrally symmetric owners at an actual marked host face, edge or vertex. Retain all26 host walls and an actual directed separating plane for every pair. Reconstruct every owner translation together. Continued returns replace ports only by separating faces of the realized pair. All owners retain the same proper canonical orientation.
